description: This file defines the StartStreaming class, which represents a message indicating a request to start streaming entities of a specified StreamingType via a connection. It includes attributes for streaming type, connection ID, authorization context, namespaces, optional filters, and extra field selectors. The class also provides a builder for creating instances with a fluent API.

classes.name: StartStreaming
classes.description: Immutable class representing a request to start streaming entities of a specific type, with associated connection info, authorization, namespaces, optional filter, and extra fields.

classes.name: StartStreaming.StartStreamingBuilder
classes.description: Mutable builder class providing a fluent API to construct StartStreaming instances, allowing configuration of namespaces, filters, and extra fields before creation.

methods.name: getBuilder
methods.description: Static method to create a new builder for constructing StartStreaming instances, requiring streaming type, connection ID, and authorization context.

methods.name: getStreamingType
methods.description: Returns the type of entity to be streamed.

methods.name: getConnectionCorrelationId
methods.description: Returns the connection or session correlation ID.

methods.name: getAuthorizationContext
methods.description: Returns the authorization context of the connection.

methods.name: getNamespaces
methods.description: Returns the list of namespaces for which signals should be emitted.

methods.name: getFilter
methods.description: Returns the optional RQL filter applied before publishing events.

methods.name: getExtraFields
methods.description: Returns an optional JsonFieldSelector for enriching outgoing signals.
